reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel spatial gradient annealing experiment to create a continuous variation in LCO within a single sample, enabling direct correlation of local LCO with local mechanical properties. This controlled comparison goes beyond the existing literature, which only reports uniform LCO states from different annealing temperatures or notes spatial variations without a designed gradient. The idea of using a gradient to map structure-property relationships is a new experimental design not suggested in any passage.
